content_sections.heading: Post-wise Details
content_sections.text: Qualification required: Degree in Civil Engineering with minimum 60% marks with 5 years experience in Hydrographic Survey with minimum 60%; OR Diploma in Civil Engineering with minimum 60% marks with 15 years Experience in the field of Hydrographic Survey; OR An Ex-Officer of Indian Navy with 10 years of Experience in Hydrographic Survey; Knowledge of computerized survey operations using electronic position systems and computerized charting computations and navigational appliances. Experience required: 5 years (Degree) / 15 years (Diploma) / 10 years (Ex-Navy Officer) in Hydrographic Survey. Age limit: 18 to 45 years. Pay: Rs. 1,00,000. Qualification required: Degree in Civil Engineering with minimum 60% marks or equivalent qualification from a Board/Institute recognized by Govt. of India with 3 years post qualification experience; OR Diploma in Civil Engineering with minimum 60% marks or equivalent qualification from a Board/Institute recognized by Govt. of India with 6 years post qualification experience. Experience required: 3 years (Degree) or 6 years (Diploma) post qualification experience in Civil construction/maintenance. Age limit: 18 to 30 years. Pay: Rs. 45,000. Qualification required: M.Sc. Environment/Environmental Science/M.Tech/ME Environmental Engineering/M.Sc. Zoology with minimum 60% marks; minimum 5 years experience, of which minimum 2 years in Port Sector. Experience required: Minimum 5 years (Ports, Maritime Sector, Government Institutes, Environmental Consultancy), of which minimum 2 years in Port Sector. Age limit: 18 to 35 years. Pay: Rs. 45,000.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Initial engagement of two years from the effective date of the contract, extendable up to another one year on same terms Minimum 8 hours per shift, 6 days a week including Saturday; no extra wages for extra hours Annual increment up to 10% will be considered on recommendation and satisfactory performance report Contract can be terminated by either side by giving one month's notice No right to regularization, absorption or permanent appointment 12 Casual leaves per year; no carry forward or encashment
